i.norm: A supplementary character (codepoint above U+FFFF, here U+210C1) is encoded in Java as a surrogate pair. When escaping for a charset that cannot represent it (ASCII), it must be emitted as a numeric character reference; when escaping for a charset that can represent it (UTF-8), it must be left unchanged.
U+210C1 is a supplementary-plane codepoint, built as its surrogate-pair String.
ASCII cannot encode the character, so it is escaped as a hex numeric reference.
UTF-8 can encode the character directly, so it is left unchanged.
